title: Crystal melt stored by Trade at Central Nexus carried to the station bid at Cargo Lanes Freight Depot (Nebula) and sold there
note: 2026-11-23 06:07 UTC (Mercury): orders ENT-078, block MERCURY and P5. Cargo Lanes Freight Depot's own station bid for crystal melt: 2,122 x 43 (view_market, 06:06 UTC); Central Nexus bids 54. Trade's own storage at Central Nexus holds 235 melt (table holdings). 20 jumps (scripts/map.py route). The carrier withdraws 43, sells at 2,000 or better, stores what is left at Cargo Lanes. requires.bid closes it while Cargo Lanes shows no bid at 2,000. Nothing is bought. A test: one ship (F37).
